title: ReMMD: Realistic Multilingual Multi-Image Agentic Verification for Multimodal Misinformation Detection
title_zh: ReMMD：面向多模态虚假信息检测的真实多语言多图 Agentic 验证框架
abstract_en: Multimodal misinformation detection is increasingly important because viral posts now combine long multilingual narratives, several images, mixed provenance, and subtle text--image framing errors. Existing benchmarks and methods remain poorly matched to this setting: they usually isolate short captions, single images, binary labels, or one manipulation source, while agentic verification remains costly under realistic evidence search. We present ReMMD, a realistic multilingual multi-image agentic verification framework for multimodal misinformation detection. ReMMD includes ReMMDBench, a real-world multimodal misinformation detection benchmark with 500 samples, 2,756 images, five monolingual languages, two cross-lingual settings, three text-length tiers, multi-image posts, five-way veracity labels, eight distortion labels, evidence provenance, and rationales. It also includes ReMMD-Agent, a persistent-memory verifier that decomposes posts into atomic points, builds a reusable evidence set, and predicts structured L1/L2/L3 outputs. Across proprietary systems, open LVLMs, MMD-Agent, and T2-Agent, ReMMD-Agent obtains the best five-way veracity performance, with 41.80% accuracy and 39.12% macro-F1 using GPT-5.2, while reducing cost by 17.5% relative to MMD-Agent and 79.9% relative to T2-Agent. The project is available at https://dang-ai.github.io/ReMMD.
abstract_zh: 本文提出 ReMMD，一个面向真实场景的多语言、多图像、Agentic 验证框架，用于多模态虚假信息检测。现有基准和方法通常局限于短 caption、单图、二分类标签或单一篡改来源，难以覆盖病毒式传播帖文中常见的长篇多语言叙事、多图混合来源以及细微的文图 framing 错误。ReMMD 包含 ReMMDBench：一个真实世界基准，涵盖 500 个样本、2,756 张图像、5 种单语语言、2 种跨语言设置、3 个文本长度层级、多图帖文、五分类真实性标签、8 类失真标签、证据来源与解释理由。框架还包含 ReMMD-Agent：一种带持久记忆的验证器，可将帖文拆解为原子主张，构建可复用证据集，并输出结构化 L1/L2/L3 预测。在 proprietary systems、open LVLMs、MMD-Agent 和 T2-Agent 对比中，基于 GPT-5.2 的 ReMMD-Agent 取得最佳五分类真实性检测结果，accuracy 为 41.80%，macro-F1 为 39.12%，同时相较 MMD-Agent 降低 17.5% 成本，相较 T2-Agent 降低 79.9% 成本。
key_points_zh: 提出 ReMMD，针对真实多模态虚假信息场景中的长文本、多语言、多图像和复杂文图错配问题。
构建 ReMMDBench，包含 500 个样本、2,756 张图像、五分类真实性标签、8 类失真标签及证据来源和 rationales。
设计 ReMMD-Agent，通过原子主张拆解、持久记忆和可复用证据集进行结构化 L1/L2/L3 验证。
在多类基线对比中，ReMMD-Agent with GPT-5.2 达到 41.80% accuracy 和 39.12% macro-F1，为最佳五分类真实性表现。
相比 MMD-Agent 和 T2-Agent，ReMMD-Agent 分别降低 17.5% 和 79.9% 的验证成本。

llm_assessment.comment: Useful agentic verification benchmark and memory-based verifier, but its value is mostly task-specific to misinformation detection rather than general agent harness infrastructure.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 该工作提供了有用的智能体验证基准和记忆式验证器，但主要价值偏向虚假信息检测任务而非通用智能体基础设施。
